description.label: Description
description.value:
You channel through the winds briefly forcing into your service a mighty ally. @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-bestiary.Actor.pngADezTmQbEm3G9]{Djinn} immediately manifests. Perform an Opposed Channel/Willpower Test with the Djinn. If successful, the Djinn will respond to any commands issued by the caster, then vanish once the duration ends. If failed, the Djinn immediately turns on its master and must be destroyed. For every +2 SL you may add an additional Optional Trait for the Djinn prior to its manifestation; however, the Djinn will maintain these Traits even if it turns against you. The element the Djinn is manifested from is determined randomly and gains attributes based on the results. Roll a d10 and refer to the table below for the type of Djinn summoned:

Roll Djinn Element: All Lore Effects apply when casting.
1 @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-bestiary.Actor.BSmye4uGN8FUsHrX]{Light}: Gains the Impact Quality for all physical attacks against Daemons.
2 @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-bestiary.Actor.dU8b6zCqbXH27QuO]{Metal}: Gains +5 Armor Points.
3 @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-bestiary.Actor.YeTtm6QImWKOqKQl]{Life}: Gains the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.SfUUdOGjdYpr3KSR]{Regenerate} Trait.
4 @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-bestiary.Actor.lm1UsTjkTyzcBe70]{Heavens}: Gains the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.uqGxFOEqeurwkAO3]{Breath} +5 Lightning Trait.
5 @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-bestiary.Actor.e7xqZt4FMSAa5X5p]{Shadow}: Gains the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.uqGxFOEqeurwkAO3]{Breath} +5 Smoke Trait.
6 @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-bestiary.Actor.UsLgUwPFs1irOOwi]{Death}: Gains the Impact Quality for all physical attacks against @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.PFTD9gDvRWW9uh5g]{Undead}.
7 @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-bestiary.Actor.JOC4NfR16GxRJCFv]{Fire}: Gains the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.uqGxFOEqeurwkAO3]{Breath} +5 Fire Trait.
8 @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-bestiary.Actor.5e9DhxCRsy9WMxx2]{Beast}: Gains the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.yRhhOlt18COq4e1q]{Frenzy} Trait.
9 @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-bestiary.Actor.sldvAhi78DJChJ6Q]{Ice}: Gains the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.uqGxFOEqeurwkAO3]{Breath} +5 Frost Trait.
10 @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-bestiary.Actor.njHNgkDoYwGtj0mz]{Dhar}: Gains the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.kJNAY1YRaCy9IgmT]{Terror (3)} Trait.
